title: The Lost Gnomes
summary: Break cocoons and lead the rescued gnomes to safety.
overview: Break cocoons and lead the rescued gnomes to safety.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Clear a safe route before opening more cocoons.
Tell a freed gnome to follow and remain close while escorting it to the rescue area.
Use the stop dialogue when the group needs to clear ahead.
Some rescued gnomes develop a dangerous infestation; be ready for a hostile burst along the route.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
